evidence.strategic_fidelity: The portfolio includes some lower-TRL exploratory technologies (TRL5: Chiplet Architecture, Energy-Efficient AI Accelerators, Sensor Fusion Algorithms) consistent with 기술선도, but the heavy concentration on hardware infrastructure (HBM, packaging, chiplets) rather than pioneering ADAS-specific algorithmic or sensing innovations dilutes the technology leadership signal; the scoring uniformity across all technologies also suggests insufficient differentiation in R&D prioritization.
evidence.competitive_awareness: The technology selection covers relevant ADAS compute stack layers (memory, packaging, accelerators, domain controllers) which reflects awareness of the broader competitive landscape, but there is no explicit differentiation rationale, no evidence of gap exploitation relative to named competitors, and no timing advantage design explicitly targeting competitor weaknesses.

evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (HBM, chiplets, advanced packaging, AI accelerators, domain controllers, sensor fusion) are all active areas of both patent filing and market growth in the ADAS/autonomous driving space, suggesting general awareness of convergence zones; however, the uniform scoring across all market_opp and strategic_fit dimensions (all 4.0/5.0) implies the selection may not have been rigorously calibrated to identify peak convergence zones versus broad trend areas.
